Introduction

Triger (formerly known as Trigger) is a five-member boy group under DY Entertainment. They have been active in Japan since August 26, 2018, before making their debut on March 6, 2019, with the single album "Busted".

On August 9, 2024, they announced their fandom name Triing meaning Triger and fans will be connected as one like a ring.
